scripts.update-dependencies: npm run update-lavajet && npm run update-decaf
scripts.update-decaf: PREFIX="decaf-ts"; npm ls | grep "$PREFIX" | awk -F/ '{print $NF}' | sed 's/@.*//' | NPM_TOKEN=$(cat .npmtoken) xargs -I package npm update @"$PREFIX"/package
scripts.update-lavajet: PREFIX="bagacito"; npm ls | grep "$PREFIX" | awk -F/ '{print $NF}' | sed 's/@.*//' | NPM_TOKEN=$(cat .npmtoken) xargs -I package  npm update @"$PREFIX"/package
scripts.set-git-auth: git config url."https://api:$(cat .token)@github.com/".insteadOf "https://github.com/" && git config url."https://ssh:$(cat .token)@github.com/".insteadOf "ssh://git@github.com/" && git config url."https://git:$(cat .token)@github.com/".insteadOf "git@github.com:"
scripts.reset: rm -rf * && git checkout . && git pull && npm run do-install
scripts.start: npx dotenv -e ../.env.local -e ../.env.secret -e ../.env.sso -- node lib/bin/cli.js nest boot
scripts.start:cli: npx dotenv -e ../.env.local -e ../.env.secret -e ../.env.sso -- node lib/bin/cli.js nest boot
scripts.start:prod: npx dotenv -e ../.env.local -e ../.env.secret -e ../.env.sso -- node lib/bin/cli.js nest boot
scripts.prepare-release: npm run build && npm run extract:api
scripts.extract:api: npx dotenv -e ../.env -e ../.env.secret -e ../.env.sso -- npx decaf nest export-api --input ./lib/app.module.js  --output ./ --fileName lavajet-api-temp --title "Lavajet API" --description "Includes the full Api definition for the Lavajet For MAH"
scripts.prepare-pr: npm run lint-fix && npm run build:prod && npm run coverage && npm run docs
scripts.drawings: for FILE in workdocs/drawings/*.drawio; do echo "converting $FILE to image..." && docker run --rm -v $(pwd):/data rlespinasse/drawio-export --format png $FILE; done && cp -rf workdocs/drawings/export/* workdocs/resources/
scripts.uml: cd workdocs/uml && for FILE in ./*.puml; do docker run --rm -v $(pwd):/work -w /work miy4/plantuml -DPLANTUML_LIMIT_SIZE=8192 -tpng $FILE; done && cd ../.. && cp -fr workdocs/uml/*.png workdocs/resources/
scripts.docs: npx rimraf ./docs && mkdir docs && npx decaf build --docs
scripts.docker:build: DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 docker build --no-cache --secret id=TOKEN,src=$PWD/.npmtoken --target=production -t ghcr.io/bagacito/lavajet-backend:$(cat package.json | jq -r '.version') -t ghcr.io/bagacito/lavajet-backend:${VERSION:-latest} -f ./Dockerfile .
scripts.docker:build-dev: DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 docker build --no-cache --secret id=TOKEN,src=$PWD/.npmtoken --target=dev -t ghcr.io/bagacito/lavajet-backend-dev:$(cat package.json | jq -r '.version') -t ghcr.io/bagacito/lavajet-backend-dev:${VERSION:-latest} -f ./Dockerfile .
scripts.docker:build-base: DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 docker build --no-cache --secret id=TOKEN,src=$PWD/.npmtoken --target=builder -t ghcr.io/bagacito/lavajet-backend:base-$(cat package.json | jq -r '.version') -t ghcr.io/bagacito/lavajet-backend:base-${VERSION:-latest} -f ./Dockerfile .
scripts.docker:publish: docker push ghcr.io/bagacito/lavajet-backend:$(cat package.json | jq -r '.version') && docker push ghcr.io/bagacito/lavajet-backend:${VERSION:-latest}
scripts.docker:publish-dev: docker push ghcr.io/bagacito/lavajet-backend-dev:$(cat package.json | jq -r '.version') && docker push ghcr.io/bagacito/lavajet-backend-dev:${VERSION:-latest}
scripts.docker:publish-base: docker push ghcr.io/bagacito/lavajet-backend:base-$(cat package.json | jq -r '.version') && docker push ghcr.io/bagacito/lavajet-backend:base-${VERSION:-latest}
